snippet.title: KingFish Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
KingFish a 2-player asymmetric co-op game where a King and a Giant Fish, a living island, build a city, travel between islands, and defend their kingdom together. One goal, different roles, perspectives and information. Wishlist on Steam!

Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3942260/KingFish
Discuss on Discord  → https://discord.gg/kingfishgame
Watch on TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@kingfishgame
